camel_example: aliyun live AddStudioLayout --region cn-hangzhou --LayoutName Test_layout --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --LayoutType studio --CasterId 'a2b8e671-2fe5-4642-a2ec-bf93880e0000'
description_en: Adds layout settings for a virtual production studio
description_zh: 添加虚拟演播厅的布局设置
kebab_example: aliyun live add-studio-layout --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --caster-id a2b8e671-2fe5-4642-a2ec-bf93880e0000 --layout-name Test_layout --layout-type studio --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddStudioLayout

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the production studio.

<notice>

Create a virtual production studio in advance. You can create a production studio in the console or by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69338.html API operation. The production studio must be a virtual production studio.

</notice>

If you call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html API operation to create a production studio, use the returned CasterId value.

If you create a production studio in the ApsaraVideo Live console, go to the ApsaraVideo Live console > Production Studio > Cloud Production Studio page. The name of the production studio in the list is its ID.

The name of the production studio in the list on the Cloud Production Studio page is the production studio ID
parameters.help_zh:
导播台ID。

<notice>需要提前创建好，必须是虚拟演播厅类型的导播台。可通过控制台或调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69338.html接口添加导播台，类型需选择虚拟演播厅。
</notice>

如果您通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html创建导播台，请查看CreateCaster接口调用返回的参数CasterId值。

如果您通过直播控制台创建导播台，请通过直播控制台 > 导播台 > 云导播台页面查看。

直播控制台云导播台页面导播台列表中的导播台名称即导播台ID
parameters.name: caster_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the studio layout
parameters.name: layout_name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the studio layout. Valid values:

common: A common layout. If you set LayoutType to common, you must also specify CommonConfig.

studio: A studio layout. If you set LayoutType to studio, you must also specify BgImageConfig and ScreenInputConfigList. The MediaInputConfigList parameter is optional
parameters.help_zh:
演播厅布局类型。取值：

common：通用布局。当LayoutType取值为common时，请求参数CommonConfig为必填。
studio：演播厅布局。当LayoutType取值为studio时，请求参数BgImageConfig和ScreenInputConfigList为必填，MediaInputConfigList为选填
parameters.name: layout_type

parameters.help_en:
The configuration of the common layout. The value is a JSON string. For more information, see CommonConfig.

<notice>

This parameter is required only when you set LayoutType to common.

</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
通用布局配置。格式为JSON字符串，请参见CommonConfig。

<notice>当请求参数LayoutType取值为common时，本参数才必填。
</notice>
parameters.name: common_config

parameters.help_en:
The configuration of the background resource. The value is a JSON string. For more information, see BgImageConfig.

<notice>

This parameter is required only when you set LayoutType to studio.

</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
背景资源配置。格式为JSON字符串，请参见BgImageConfig。

<notice>当请求参数LayoutType取值为studio时，本参数才必填。
</notice>
parameters.name: bg_image_config

parameters.help_en:
The settings for the chroma keying input. The value is a JSON string. For more information, see ScreenInputConfig.

<notice>

This parameter is required only when you set LayoutType to studio.

</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
抠像输入设置。格式为JSON字符串，请参见ScreenInputConfig。

<notice>当请求参数LayoutType取值为studio时，本参数才必填。
</notice>
parameters.name: screen_input_config_list

parameters.help_en:
The settings for the multimedia input resource. The value is a JSON string. For more information, see MediaInputConfig.

<notice>

This parameter is valid and optional only when you set LayoutType to studio.

</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
多媒体输入资源设置。格式为JSON字符串，请参见MediaInputConfig。

<notice>当请求参数LayoutType取值为studio时，本参数才有效，且为选填。
</notice>
parameters.name: media_input_config_list

parameters.help_en: The layer order settings. The value is a JSON string. For more information, see LayerOrderConfig. You can sort background materials and multimedia materials. Chroma keying layers are not supported. The earlier a material appears in the list, the lower its layer
parameters.help_zh:
图层顺序设置。格式为JSON字符串，请参见layerOrderConfig。
支持背景素材、多媒体素材排序，暂不支持抠像层。越排在前面，越在底层
parameters.name: layer_order_config_list

LayoutId.description_en: The layout ID. Use this ID to delete, modify, or query a virtual production studio layout
LayoutId.description_zh: 布局ID。可作为删除虚拟演播厅布局、修改虚拟演播厅布局和查询虚拟演播厅布局的请求参数
